Name: More Pet Bowls for Alternative Textures
Author: LCKa
Description:
DellyBelly's More Pet Bowls mod (available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22161]here[/url]) offers a significant variety of pet bowls, in red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple and pink, with a design made for cats in mind and another one that favors dogs. It also has one feature I really loved, 3 different floors to choose from, or even no floor. This mod, with DellyBelly's permission, simply makes them all available through Alternative Textures, so that you can change the look of your pet bowls at any time, and enjoy visual variety if you have many pets (and since the base game now allows us to, why wouldn't you have as many pets as stardewvalleyly possible??).

There are thus 102 versions to choose from, plus four bonus ones taken from aedenthorn's Moveable Pet Bowl ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8038]here[/url]﻿), made well before SDV 1.6 was released and integrated it to the base game. aedenthorn has since retired from SDV modding, and opened permissions for all their mods (the announcement can be found [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424/1194051284177801307]here[/url]). So I incorporated the prismatic, iridium, diamond and golden pet bowls (without any floor) from that mod since they offer a nice visual contrast.

Thank you very much to DellyBelly for giving me permission to publish the Alternative Textures version of their mod. All kudos should be theirs by right, but if you have a technical issue, ask me, please. All the assets, with the exception of aedenthorn's four bowls, belong to them.

This mod pairs very well with More Doghouses, also by DellyBelly, which has its original Content Patcher version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30266]here[/url], and its own Alternative Textures [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31707]version[/url], since they have the same color palette.

To change your pet bowls, buy a paint bucket at Robin's and choose the texture you want.
The mod should work for old and new saves alike.
